Agency: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development
Committee: Rural and Regional Affairs and Transport
Portfolio: Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development
QuestionText:
A new Division has been added to the Department's organisation chart - Transport Sector Skills Division:
Could you provide an overview of the work of this Division?
How many staff have been allocated to this task?
Is there a work program? Can you share it with the committee?
How is the Division working with commonwealth/state/territory agencies and industry?
What is the budget for this work?
Which parts of the transport sector are covered by your work?
Does the work of the Division include all elements of the transport sector - aviation, road, rail and shipping?
